info.title: Dashboard Computer Vision API
info.description: Shared API contract for the Dashboard Computer Vision pilot backend. Mutating endpoints require authenticated operator/admin sessions unless noted otherwise. Optimistic concurrency mutations require expectedVersion.

get.summary: Read the aggregated operational dashboard summary
Read the latest analysis summary for a single media source

post.summary: Exchange a guarded pilot token for an httpOnly session cookie
post.description: Requires x-session-exchange-key when AUTH_SESSION_EXCHANGE_ENABLED is true. Intended as pilot interim auth, not a public login flow.
Camera sources are SSRF-validated before persistence. Upload sources must resolve under managed upload roots.

put.summary: Replace a media source with optimistic concurrency

delete.summary: Delete a media source with optimistic concurrency

patch.summary: Update monitoring state for a media source

put.summary: Update module configuration with optimistic concurrency

patch.summary: Patch a model dataset with optimistic concurrency
Patch a training job with optimistic concurrency
Update model version status with optimistic concurrency
Patch a model evaluation with optimistic concurrency
Patch a model benchmark with optimistic concurrency

post.summary: Start an analysis job for a supported module
post.description: Normal contract is ID-based: mediaSourceId plus optional modelVersionId/config semantics. Legacy path fields are deprecated and must remain constrained to managed roots.

get.description: Requires signed URL query parameters generated by the backend. Artifact paths must resolve under analysisOutputRoot.

post.description: Admin-only cleanup for expired or over-quota artifacts under analysisOutputRoot. Queued/running job output directories and paths outside the artifact root are skipped.

AuthError.description: Authentication failed or signed URL invalid

value.message: Item was modified by another request. Refresh and retry.

SourceLatestAnalysis.description: Latest analysis summary for a single media source
